configuration.camera: alternate every 60 simulated frames between [0,1.7,6] and [0,1.7,-6]
configuration.graphics: drawQubits and updateTarget every sixth frame; shadows off

method.timing: Wall elapsed time and whole Node-process CPU are separate. First 300 simulated frames are warmup and excluded from timing samples without resetting the production state. AB/BA/AB by default. No per-step observer or detailed counters in timing mode. Samples include advanceSimulation and every sixth frame updateTarget/drawQubits, not the browser main-thread frame or GPU. No FPS is measured.
method.trace: A separate instrumented run observes every physical step, records inventory peaks and the exact terminal battery debit, and stores at most 256 state/event snapshots per case. nativeSolve observes the native solver boundary AFTER the game wrapper changes friction bounds and BEFORE Cannon solves. solverMaxImpulseX sums maxForce*abs(tangent.x); despite the field name, this Cannon solver clamps impulse. Top-level material.friction is observed after bounds are restored. Adjusted equation counters compare live solver bounds with the default mu*m*g for the table/material pair.
method.comparison: Batch durations and workloads can differ after the physical correction. The shared 5–15 simulated-second window is also reported. No sum of subsystem percentages or claim of global FPS improvement.
method.energy: Timing reports battery debit at the end of its 60 Hz frame. Any physical steps after completion may recharge the disabled rotor, so that endpoint is not an exact terminal-energy invariant. Trace mode and production-frequency.test.cjs verify debit at the terminal physical step.
method.memory: Trace/sample arrays are tool-only and bounded by 256 snapshots / 3600 simulated frames per run. nativeSolveCounters reports material-body and adjusted-equation peaks for estimating transient count/limit Map entries and restore tuples; these are entry counts, not allocated bytes or retained-heap measurements.
